title: Define the Mini language tree
description: You can read the data carried by each node before the compiler visits it.

steps.description: Literal nodes store values, with Nil carrying no fields. Name stores a variable name, while Assign also stores its value expression.
BinOp holds an operator and two children. UnaryOp holds an operator and one operand.
If and While store conditions and statement lists. Return carries the expression to return.

steps.question: Does a Call node store a function name alone?
steps.answer: No. It stores a callee expression and a list of argument expressions.

steps.description: FunDecl stores its name, parameters, and body. Print and Block complete the statement forms, and the displayed message confirms the definitions loaded.
